name: Valheim
description: Valheim Dedicated Server lets you host a persistent co-op world for the brutal exploration and survival game Valheim. Installed bare-metal via SteamCMD with automatic startup, graceful world saves on shutdown, and world backups before every update.

notes.text: The server has no web interface. Players join via <container-ip>:2456; forward UDP ports 2456-2457 for access from the internet.
The server password is stored in /opt/valheim/valheim.env. It must be at least 5 characters and must not be part of the server name.
World saves live in /opt/valheim/data and are backed up automatically before every update.
